Hi, our robotics team has a contractor-written C file for our servo motor controller at `servo_project/firmware/src/servo_controller_draft.c`. The code is supposed to run as a hard real-time periodic control task on our Linux-based motion controller board, and it also needs to handle encoder hardware interrupts. Unfortunately, our lead engineer flagged it as completely non-compliant with our internal RT standards before leaving on vacation.

Please review the draft file and produce a corrected, production-ready version saved as `rt_servo_controller.c`. The fixed code must address every RT compliance issue in the draft. It should run a 1ms periodic control loop reading from memory-mapped hardware registers (base address 0xF0000000, size 0x1000), handle encoder interrupts on IRQ 47, and pin everything to CPU core 2. Don't forget to include the build instructions and the full deployment environment verification checklist that our ops team needs to validate the system before going live.
